tasks.label: ROS 2: Launch All
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch robot0_bringup bringup.launch.py

tasks.label: ROS 2: Launch App Nodes
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch robot0_bringup nodes.launch.py

tasks.label: ROS 2: Gazebo Simulation
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch robot0_gazebo gazebo.launch.py

tasks.label: ROS 2: Display Robot Model (RVIZ only)
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && ros2 launch robot0_description display.launch.py
